# ChipLab — full specification
# Local-first ITCH-50 silicon lab: RTL + WebAssembly + WebGPU + MCP + EXE + Docker + Vercel
# Version: 0.3.1 "Local Cloud"

## 1. What it is
ChipLab is a pre-silicon lab around a NASDAQ TotalView-ITCH 5.0 parser. The RTL
(`rtl/`) is the hardware specification; the Rust/WASM core (`wasm-core/`) is the
executable twin used by the browser, Node, MCP, npm, PyPI and the single EXE.

## 2. RTL
- Top: `ultra_low_latency_nasdaq_itch50_cutthrough`, parameters DATA_WIDTH 128/256/512.
- `itch_shifter.sv`: tkeep-aware, cleared append window, 512-bit sliding window.
- `itch_parser_core.sv`: all 22 official opcodes, full 512-bit payload, 64-bit shares.
- `itch_top.sv`: tkeep/tlast, registered egress, async bypass, counters.
- `moldudp64_frontend.sv`: Ethernet/IPv4/UDP filter, Mold header, seq/gap.
- `moldudp64_depacketizer.sv`: strips per-message 2-byte length prefixes.
- `moldudp64_pipeline.sv`: multi-frame end-to-end (5 frames, gap + drop) PASS.

Latency (honest):
- s_axis_tdata -> window register: 1 clock.
- window -> registered output: 1 clock.
- wire-to-registered-output: 2 clocks (6.20 ns at 322.26 MHz).
- async bypass: same cycle as window, not zero from the wire.

## 3. Protocol coverage
S 12, R 39, H 25, Y 20, L 26, V 35, W 12, K 28, J 35, h 21, A 36, F 40, E 31,
C 36, X 23, D 19, U 35, P 44, Q 40, B 19, I 50, N 20 bytes.

## 4. Verification
- `tb/itch_model.py`: independent reference, 80-byte canonical record.
- `tb/sim_main.cpp`: full-field Verilator regression.
- 1,000,000 records, 0 mismatches, 31,383,973 bytes, 1,961,516 cycles, 41.290 Gbps.
- `formal/itch_formal.sv`: pre-trigger equivalence, class exclusivity, legal lengths,
  register equivalence, flow control. Z3 PASS, CVC5 PASS, Boolector 1.5 unsupported.
- `formal/solver_matrix.sh`, `scripts/mutate.py`, `scripts/synth_matrix.sh`.
- Yosys cells: 22,629 (128), 25,201 (256), 29,628 (512); 2,228 DFFs.
- OpenLane configs are flow-ready; no P&R/Fmax sign-off is claimed.

## 5. Web/WASM
- `web/worker.js` owns the WASM memory; `web/core.js` decodes records.
- `web/gpu.js`: WebGPU compute bins + render; Canvas2D fallback.
- `web/app.js`: responsive dense-tool UI, Worker, OPFS history, PWA.
- 1M messages in 664 ms wall on the test host, 0 errors.

## 6. Backend/MCP/API
- `backend/server.mjs`: `/api/health`, `/api/chips`, `/api/run`, `/api/compare`, `/api/book`,
  `/api/cloud/info`, `/api/store[/:namespace]`.
- Local cloud: atomic JSON store under `.data/`, 1 MB cap, revision conflicts, optional
  bearer token; loopback-only writes without a token. Flags: `--host --port --token --data-dir`.
- `backend/run.mjs`: CLI.
- `mcp/server.mjs` (12 read-only tools): `chiplab.chips`, `chiplab.run`, `chiplab.compare`,
  `chiplab.book`, `chiplab.formal_status`, `chiplab.health`, `chiplab.cloud_info`,
  `chiplab.history`, `chiplab.release_status`, `chiplab.sbom`, `chiplab.synth_status`,
  `chiplab.docs` (fixed 8-key catalog).
- `api/*.mjs`: Vercel serverless wrappers; static-first, user data stays in the browser.

## 6b. Release (v0.3.1)
- One version across npm, Cargo, PyPI, MCP, SBOM and the Vercel health endpoint.
- `Release` workflow on tag `v*`: verify → EXE → npm/PyPI packages → SBOM →
  `SHA256SUMS.txt` → GitHub Release.
- `scripts/release_check.mjs` gates version/changelog/artifacts; `scripts/checksums.mjs`
  writes the manifest.

## 7. Distribution
- `npm run build:exe` -> `dist/chiplab.exe` (Node SEA, embedded web + WASM + local cloud).
- `Dockerfile` -> non-root Node 22 alpine, healthcheck; set `CHIPLAB_TOKEN` for writes.
- `vercel.json` + `scripts/build_vercel.mjs` -> `public/` + `api/`.
- npm `@chiplab/core`; PyPI `chiplab-itch`.
- Native `chiplab-native` (wgpu Vulkan/DX12, `--probe`, `--boost`).

## 8. Honest limits
Pre-silicon, synthetic feed, no tapeout, no Fmax sign-off, multi-frame Mold flow control
open, WebGPU f32 only for visual heights. Not investment advice.

## 9. Licence
PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0. Attribution string required under $100k annual revenue.
